abstract_class_config.class_description: E2A base for SAP BOPF Audit BO — RAG-based anomaly detection, policy retrieval, LLM classification, S3 archival

generator.user_prompt: Generate an AuditAIAgent that extends BaseAuditAgent. It is an async Kafka consumer of SettlementCompletedEvent. It runs a RAG pipeline: (1) embed the settlement transaction description using Spring AI EmbeddingClient, (2) similarity-search ChromaDB vector store for top-3 relevant financial policy document chunks, (3) send a structured LLM prompt (compliance officer role, transaction + policy context) to ChatClient, (4) parse the JSON LLM response {anomaly: bool, reason: string, severity: LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH}, (5) persist AuditLog entity to PostgreSQL, (6) on anomaly=true archive full audit JSON to S3. Implements SAP BOPF Audit BO pattern.
generator.system_prompt_additions: NFR: RAGPipelineIdempotency, LLMResponseMustBeStructuredJSON, AuditLogImmutable, S3ArchivalOnAnomaly, ChromaDBSimilaritySearchTop3
